effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When a Digimon attacks, by suspending this Tamer, you may place the top 2 cards of your deck face down under this Tamer. After, if it's your opponent's turn, by trashing 4 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, you may use 1 black [BEATBREAK] trait Option card from your hand without paying the cost.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
